styles.name: Geometric
styles.blurb: Clean lines, symmetry and sacred-geometry patterns that hold their shape for decades.

styles.name: Japanese
styles.blurb: Irezumi tradition: bold outlines, flowing water, dragons, koi and cherry blossoms.

styles.name: Minimalist
styles.blurb: Small, quiet, single-needle designs for people who want ink without the noise.

styles.name: Blackwork
styles.blurb: Heavy solid black, high contrast and negative space used as a design element.

styles.name: Fine Line
styles.blurb: Delicate single-needle linework — floral, script and portrait detail at hairline scale.

styles.name: Traditional
styles.blurb: American traditional: bold outlines, limited palette, swallows, anchors and roses.

styles.name: Realism
styles.blurb: Photographic shading and depth — portraits, animals and nature rendered in skin.

styles.name: Tribal
styles.blurb: Polynesian, Maori and Filipino patterns where every mark carries meaning.

styles.name: Watercolor
styles.blurb: Washed colour, splatter and brushstroke effects without hard outlines.

styles.name: Neo-Traditional
styles.blurb: Traditional bones with a modern palette, richer detail and dimensional shading.

styles.name: Ornamental
styles.blurb: Mandalas, dotwork and jewellery-like patterns built to flow with the body.

styles.name: Script & Lettering
styles.blurb: Typography, dates, names and quotes — placement and font choice decide legibility.

styles.name: Anime & Manga
styles.blurb: Panel art, characters and symbols from manga and anime, from subtle to full sleeve.

styles.name: Floral
styles.blurb: Peonies, roses, wildflowers and botanical line art in every size and style.

styles.name: Snake & Dragon
styles.blurb: Serpents and dragons that wrap the arm, spine or shoulder as one flowing shape.

styles.name: Small & Simple
styles.blurb: First-tattoo territory: tiny symbols, coordinates, dots and one-word designs.
